answers: design finding 1: done — Changed DSLOCK-3's Then from "at least one assertion labelled [O4] is present in route-one-call-per-try-test.sh" to "git diff is run between the base commit and HEAD restricting to tests/unit/route-one-call-per-try-test.sh; the diff output is empty."
